summary: Seabridge Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval of an arrangement under the Canada Business Corporations Act, whereby the company and its shareholders will receive shares of Valor Gold Corp. Per the voting results, 99.76% of votes supported the arrangement. This is a shareholder vote on a definitive arrangement to exchange Seabridge shares for Valor shares, effectively making Seabridge a wholly-owned subsidiary of Valor in a reverse merger/plan of arrangement. The filing confirms the arrangement's passage at a special meeting. The deal eliminates Seabridge's public listing; watch for final court approval and closing risk.
